title: The weekly three-way count
purpose: Every week the registry, MDM, and room say the same number, so a missing phone is found before anyone asks.
with: the Planning and Logistics Lead and the operator
when: Every Thursday at 4:00 PM, during the check-in, before the full flush.

steps.do: Get both lists before you count
steps.who: The Planning and Logistics Lead sends the registry list
steps.detail: A late list never stops the count.

steps.do: Count each phone by tag as it docks
steps.check: Every tag has a tick or a note.

steps.do: Count the kit against the kit list
steps.check: Every kit line has a number.

steps.do: Compare registry, MDM, and room, tag by tag
steps.check: You can name the tag behind every difference.

steps.do: Chase every difference today, missing phones first
steps.check: Every difference has a cause or a deadline.

steps.do: Replace broken or short items from the spares
steps.check: The Planning and Logistics Lead has the replacement list by tag or kit line.

steps.do: Send every phone to the full flush
steps.check: Every tag is on a signed phone list or uploading here.

steps.do: Put the count in the evening check-out
steps.detail: The site lead writes it under anything else. Send the Planning and Logistics Lead the signed sheet.
steps.check: The Planning and Logistics Lead corrects the registry today.

done: Every difference has a cause or a deadline, and the Planning and Logistics Lead has the signed sheet.

fails.if: A phone is not in the room
fails.then: Ask its last wearer. Lost mode within the hour. Wipe and police report only after 24 hours.

fails.if: A phone is not on the map
fails.then: Charge it, open the collection app. Still dark after an hour: it does not go out. The Planning and Logistics Lead sends a spare.

fails.if: The registry has it at another site
fails.then: A transfer nobody wrote down. Tell the Planning and Logistics Lead today. The registry row moves tonight.

fails.if: A phone is held at the hub
fails.then: The hub attendant confirms the tag. Write at hub with the date. A second night is an incident. Tell Moharam.

escalate: Moharam within the hour for a missing phone, and after 24 hours for anything still unexplained.
